nodes.name: Sklearn Inspection Public API Shell
nodes.description: High-level partial_dependence and permutation_importance function-selection, callback-boundary, call-payload, and result-summary atoms above estimator response, scorer, feature-shuffle, recursion, grid, and joblib execution.

nodes.name: inspection_public_function_catalog
nodes.description: Expose public sklearn inspection function names useful for framework-level workflow selection.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed public function-name tuple and does not inspect data.

nodes.name: inspection_public_function_boundary
nodes.description: Return the estimator-response or scorer-shuffle callback boundary represented by a public inspection function.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a constant-time branch over fixed public function names.

nodes.name: partial_dependence_call_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public partial_dependence payload for finite dense inputs without executing estimator responses, grid construction, recursion, or brute-force loops.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, X: object, features: object, sample_weight: object = None, categorical_features: object = None, feature_names: object = None, response_method: str = 'auto', percentiles: tuple[float, float] = (0.05, 0.95), grid_resolution: int = 100, custom_values: object = None, method: str = 'auto', kind: str = 'average') -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense inputs and public options, then packages references without executing inspection callbacks.

nodes.name: permutation_importance_call_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public permutation_importance payload for finite dense inputs without executing scorer, shuffle, subsampling, or joblib callbacks.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, X: object, y: object, scoring: object = None, n_repeats: int = 5, n_jobs: int | None = None, random_state: int | None = None, sample_weight: object = None, max_samples: int | float = 1.0) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense inputs and public permutation options, then packages references without scoring or shuffling.

nodes.name: partial_dependence_result_summary
nodes.description: Expose grid-value lengths plus average and individual prediction shapes from a public partial_dependence result.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom reads already-produced grid vectors and prediction-array shapes without recomputing predictions.

nodes.name: permutation_importance_result_summary
nodes.description: Expose metric count, metric names, feature count, and importance-array shape from a public permutation_importance result.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom reads already-produced metric keys and importance-array shapes without recomputing scores.

metadata.remediation_case: Case 3 and Case 4 public inspection function shells over estimator response, scorer, shuffle, recursion, grid, and joblib callback boundaries
limitations: Estimator prediction, probability, decision-function, scorer callbacks, feature shuffling, subsampling, grid construction, recursion, brute-force loops, and joblib scheduling remain delegated behavior.
The shell models finite dense public API routing and compact result-shape packaging, not inspection workflow execution.
